title: Deployment & Containerization

docker_audit_findings.summary: well-formed, built and run for real for the first time this phase

sqlalchemy/psycopg/alembic missing from requirements.txt despite being imported unconditionally at module load time; container crashed on startup with ModuleNotFoundError; never caught because no clean docker build had been run in this project's history
did not exist at all; created multi-stage build (node build -> nginx runtime) with SPA-fallback routing
only defined postgres; rewritten to wire postgres+backend+device-ai+frontend with health-gated depends_on and internal networking
backend had one, frontend did not

real_defect_found.description: requirements.txt was missing sqlalchemy, psycopg, and alembic despite them being required at module import time (not gated behind DEVICE_BACKEND=postgres) since at least P5.4/P5.9/P5.11; the production Docker image would crash-loop in any real deployment
real_defect_found.root_cause: these packages were only ever present because every local dev environment had them installed ad hoc; never captured in requirements.txt; never caught because no clean container build had ever been run
real_defect_found.fix: added sqlalchemy==2.0.52, psycopg[binary]==3.3.4, alembic==1.19.1 to requirements.txt, pinned to versions already exercised by the full test suite
real_defect_found.verification: rebuilt the image, container now starts cleanly and passes its HEALTHCHECK; full Python regression suite re-run at 1102/1102

live_verification.full_stack_docker_compose_up: all 4 services (postgres, backend, device-ai, frontend) reached healthy
live_verification.cross_container_proxy: backend reached device-ai by its Compose DNS name (http://device-ai:8100) over the internal bridge network, got a real (not mocked) disabled Fabric status back
live_verification.data_safety: pre-existing 35-device dataset in ecotrace-postgres survived the compose recreate (same named volume eco-trace-warriors_postgres_data) and a full down/up cycle
live_verification.graceful_shutdown: docker compose down: all containers stopped cleanly, no forced kills; standalone backend/device-ai containers individually stop-tested with exit code 0 and clean SIGTERM log lines
live_verification.current_state: stack left running (all healthy) at end of phase — useful groundwork for P7.8/P7.9; tear down with docker compose down

fabric_status: not started, honestly — no peer/orderer/CA binaries or channel artifacts exist anywhere in this repository (re-verified this phase by evidence, not carried forward as assumption); FABRIC_ENABLED=false verified live as status:disabled, not fabricated as connected
security_considerations: no hardcoded secrets in docker-compose.yml, all ${VAR:-placeholder}
frontend image serves only built static assets, no backend proxying, no sensitive VITE_*-prefixed vars
backend container hardcodes NODE_ENV=production, proving env.schema.ts's production safety checks are live (compose had to supply real-looking JWT secrets to even start)
environmental_limitations: No Hyperledger Fabric network exists anywhere in this repository or environment — not started, not claimed as running, honestly disclosed
